title: Template:WelcomeIP/doc
content: ;Description :The above template is for adding to the [[help:Talk page|Talk page]] of any contributor who is identified only by an IP number. :Note: as user IPs can change regularly, the earlier this is posted after the user's last edit, the better. ;Syntax :Just type or paste {{subst:welcomeIP}} to the IP's talk page and add your timestamp (four tildes: ~~~~) below it.
